To compute the forecast error for a forecast at time k+i, first, observations at times 1, 2, ..., k+i-1 are used to estimate the forecasting model. Then, the forecast for time k+i is computed using this model. The error on the forecast for k+i is calculated by comparing the actual observation at time k+i with the forecasted value.

This process is repeated for i = 2,...,T–k, where T is the total number of observations. The forecast accuracy can be computed by averaging the errors obtained for all forecasts.

Without any criticism of the able trial jurist who was following the decisions then existing, the two judgments adjudging the defendants of being guilty of a felony are to be reversed. The causes are to be remanded to the trial court with directions to enter a judgment of guilty of Section 800.02 instead.
